baseline_models.focus_anchor: The imperative ٱضْرِبْ, its object مَّثَلًا, and the event clause naming the settlement's companions and arriving messengers.
baseline_models.mechanism: The imperative actively renders a portable case: a socially attached collective is shown at the decisive moment when message-carriers reach it. The town episode is therefore an exemplary configuration, not merely a place-name or detached anecdote.

activation_trace.role: Depicting and making an example manifest supplies the framing action that turns the event into an inspectable case.
The struck-example branch supplies the portable exemplary form in which the town event is presented.
Companionship as sustained attachment makes the residents a relational collective rather than an accidental crowd.
The village as a gathering of people supplies the civic scale on which reception of the message is tested.
Coming and reaching a place marks arrival as the event's activating threshold.
Carriers of a message identify what crosses the settlement's threshold and why the arrival matters.

changed_reading.before: Tell them a story about a town visited by messengers.
changed_reading.after: Render for them an exemplary civic case: a bonded settlement is exposed at the moment carried speech arrives.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ joined to جَآءَهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus can be spatialized as a receiving topology. A qarya gathers people into a stable locus, its companions remain attached to it, and dispatched agents arrive from outside. The verse foregrounds a communal boundary and the collective's capacity to receive what is sent across it.

activation_trace.role: Sustained attachment binds the named people to the receiving place.
Gathering something into a settled receptacle supplies a material-spatial image for communal reception.
Directed coming supplies the inward vector across the settlement boundary.
Dispatch and release supply the outward vector whose endpoint is the town.

changed_reading.before: The town is only the backdrop for a messenger story.
changed_reading.after: The gathered settlement is itself a receiving structure whose boundary is crossed by dispatched agents.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening identifies the present addressee as one of the sent, places warning before the town case, and distinguishes those who follow the reminder. The imperative 'for them' therefore makes the old reception scene a live diagnostic mirror for the current act of reception.

activation_trace.role: The example as a sign or lesson makes the town case available for transfer to the present audience.
The same carried-message identity assigned to the current addressee links his reception to the town's messengers.
Warning that awakens caution supplies the immediate purpose for activating the earlier reception case.
Following behind supplies the responsive path against which the mirrored audience is sorted.

structural_cues: 36:3 and 36:13 place the same sent identity on opposite sides of the exemplary frame.
The focus imperative addresses 'them' after 36:6-11 has already described divergent responses to warning.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated sent-root, warning, and following; I infer that the town case maps the current audience's reception rather than remaining sealed in the past. A live alternative is that it serves only as a historical precedent without a tight role mapping.

changed_reading.before: A past town is offered as a generally relevant lesson.
changed_reading.after: The town is staged as a live mirror in which the present messenger and audience can recognize their own reception roles.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, deeds and surviving traces are written and exhaustively counted; later, bodily members disclose and testify to what was acquired. Between those frames, the struck example functions like a case entered into an evidentiary record: it preserves a reception sequence whose consequences can bear witness.

activation_trace.role: Making the example visible supplies the presentation of the case for inspection.
The example as an evidentiary sign lets the narrated sequence carry probative force.
Inscription that fixes a consequential determination supplies the record into which conduct is entered.
A remaining mark that indicates what happened makes aftermath legible as evidence.
Exhaustive counting closes the possibility that relevant parts of the case disappear.
Knowledge made explicit as testimony supplies the later adjudicative use of preserved conduct.
The acquiring limbs connect bodily action to the testimony those same members later give.

structural_cues: The focus follows directly after the writing of prior acts and their آثار.
The surah later shifts speech from mouths to hands and testimony to feet.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recording, residual marks, exhaustive count, and bodily testimony; I infer that the intervening example is functionally an evidentiary exhibit. The live alternative is that these are broad judgment motifs rather than a claim about the example's genre.

changed_reading.before: The example illustrates a moral point.
changed_reading.after: The example preserves a traceable reception case that can be inspected as evidence of how message, response, and consequence connect.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus plural unfolds into two dispatched carriers, a reinforcing third, and a tightly limited task of delivering a clarifying message. The plurality is functional redundancy: rejection of one delivery does not terminate transmission, while success is measured by arrival and clear conveyance rather than coerced assent.

activation_trace.role: Successive groups latent in the plural sent-ones supplies a relay rather than an undifferentiated crowd.
Sending in successive units realizes the focus plural as repeated transmission.
Joining one to one supplies the initial paired delivery.
Reinforcement supplies the explicit repair when the first pair is rejected.
The completing third turns numerical addition into strengthened continuity.
Delivering the message defines the relay's bounded responsibility.
Disclosure of meaning by speech makes clarity, not force, the delivery criterion.

structural_cues: 36:14 narrates pair, rejection, reinforcement, and third in one sequence.
36:17 restricts the messengers' obligation to clear delivery.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies pairing, reinforcement, a completing third, and delivery; I call this a resilient relay and infer that plurality protects transmission against rejection. The alternative is simple emphatic multiplication with no systems-like implication.

changed_reading.before: Several messengers happen to arrive together.
changed_reading.after: The town receives a reinforced relay whose continuity survives rejection and whose task ends at clear delivery.

context_deltas.mechanism: The root that names the outer example reappears inside the scene when the townspeople say the messengers are humans 'like us' and use that likeness to reject them. The example thus contains a dispute about exemplification itself: surface sameness is true, but the inference drawn from it is false.

activation_trace.role: The framed example establishes analogy as the outer rhetorical operation.
Ordinary resemblance supplies the townspeople's true premise of shared human kind.
Visible-skinned humanity identifies the surface category on which the rejection rests.
Attributing falsehood supplies the invalid conclusion drawn from genuine likeness.

structural_cues: مَثَلًا frames the scene in 36:13, while مِّثْلُنَا becomes an argument spoken within it in 36:15.
The recipients move from shared humanity to denial of sending without an intervening test of the message.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the nested recurrence of likeness and the accusation of lying; I infer that the outer example audits how analogies are used. The alternative is that the repeated root is incidental and the objection concerns only messenger humanity.

changed_reading.after: The parable also exposes a failure of analogical reasoning: resemblance can be accurate while the conclusion attached to it is corrupt.

context_deltas.mechanism: The first arrival vector brings messengers into the settlement; a second arrival begins at the city's farthest edge and moves purposefully toward them. This counter-arrival breaks the image of a homogeneous town: reception propagates from a peripheral resident inward, meeting the external message halfway.

activation_trace.role: The gathered civic collective supplies the field whose apparent unity is later split.
The messengers' coming establishes the initial inward vector.
A second coming reverses perspective by originating inside the urban field.
The farthest side supplies a sharply marked periphery from which responsive motion begins.
The city as a comprehensive gathering expands the settlement into an internally differentiated social space.
Purposeful movement toward a goal makes the resident's counter-arrival an active response.
The message-carriers become the destination toward which the peripheral witness moves and directs his people.

structural_cues: 36:13 and 36:20 both begin decisive clauses with coming.
The second arriver speaks from within the addressed qawm yet against its dominant response.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two arrivals, the far edge, purposeful motion, and support for the messengers; I infer a center-periphery reception topology in which the message elicits motion from within. The alternative is a simpler dramatic entrance with no spatial model.

changed_reading.before: Outsiders arrive before an undifferentiated town population.
changed_reading.after: External arrival triggers a counter-arrival from the civic edge, revealing an internally divided settlement and a responsive path through it.

context_deltas.mechanism: A man identified with the town's people is told to enter the garden, and the surah later names 'companions of the garden.' This sequence makes companionship a changeable affiliation rather than a fixed geographic essence: one can emerge from the town collective into a differently defined company.

activation_trace.role: Attachment and company initially classify the people by their shared settlement.
The tree-covered garden supplies the new destination assigned to the town's dissenting witness.
The same companionship image reclassifies a collective by garden rather than town.
The garden becomes the locus around which the later company is named.

structural_cues: The man of 36:20 addresses 'my people' and is then told in 36:26 to enter the garden.
أَصْحَٰبَ governs both the focus settlement collective and the later garden collective.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one town member's garden entry and the later parallel companionship formula; I infer that the labels expose transferable affiliation. The alternative is a lexical parallel with no intended reclassification mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The companions of the town are a stable population label.
changed_reading.after: Town-companionship is a provisional attachment from which a responsive member can be re-affiliated with the garden.

context_deltas.mechanism: The town's end arrives by one alarming cry and leaves life stilled; the same one-cry form later interrupts ordinary dispute and finally gathers everyone into presence. Repetition scales the local reception case into a model of universal interruption and assembly.

activation_trace.role: The example as a sign supports transfer from one town-scale event to a larger event-pattern.
The terrifying cry supplies the town episode's abrupt terminating signal.
Numerical oneness compresses the local transition into a single event.
Life stilled after motion supplies the local cry's terminal effect.
The repeated alarming cry transfers the same interruption pattern to the current disputants.
A third occurrence applies the cry-pattern at universal scope.
The repeated single event formally binds local and universal transitions.
Joining what was dispersed supplies the universal counterpart to the town's civic gathering.
Near presence after gathering supplies the endpoint of the final cry.

structural_cues: صَيْحَةً وَاحِدَةً recurs at 36:29, 36:49, and 36:53.
The first occurrence closes the town narrative; the last gathers all into presence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the exact repeated cry formula and the shift from local extinction to universal gathering; I infer a deliberate scale-model relation. The alternative is a repeated judgment idiom whose local and universal uses need not map detail for detail.

changed_reading.before: The town's fate closes one cautionary story.
changed_reading.after: The town episode is a local-scale model of the same single-signal interruption that later overtakes and gathers everyone.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later likeness language is joined to creating rideable counterparts and to the measured capacity to create their like. This activates the focus pair as a generative pattern: the struck mathal is not decorative resemblance but a configured form capable of producing further recognition and action.

activation_trace.role: A type or form on which things are fashioned supplies the focus example's pattern-like capacity.
A configured image or model supplies more structure than loose verbal comparison.
Bringing a created counterpart into existence gives likeness productive force.
Resemblance identifies the relation by which another rideable instance is generated.
Actual riding shows the created likeness becoming operational rather than remaining conceptual.
Measuring and configuring creation supplies the patterned relation behind producing a like.
The recurrence of likeness at re-creation scale confirms it as a productive relation.

structural_cues: 36:42 joins خلق and مثل in an object that can be used.
36:81 again joins creating with producing their likeness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies created counterparts, use, and creation of a like; I transfer that productivity to the focus's rhetorical model. The live alternative is that later مثل means ordinary similarity and does not characterize the earlier parable's operation.

changed_reading.before: The example resembles another event and helps explain it.
changed_reading.after: The example is a configured pattern that can generate recognition, reenactment, and changed conduct in a new audience.

context_deltas.mechanism: Near the close, the human reverses the focus construction: instead of the messenger striking an example 'for them,' the human strikes an example 'for Us.' His counter-example fails because it suppresses his own creation. The surah thus stages a contest over who frames the case and whether the chosen comparison retains its causal origin.

activation_trace.role: The commanded act of rendering an example establishes the first direction of argument.
The struck-example construction supplies the formula later taken over by the opponent.
The same rendering action reverses agency when the human now constructs the example.
The repeated struck-example formula makes the late objection a counter-parable to the focus frame.
Loss of remembered origin identifies the hidden deletion that corrupts the counter-example.
Original bringing-into-existence supplies the omitted causal premise.

structural_cues: 36:13 has the command 'strike for them an example'; 36:78 says the human 'struck for Us an example.'
The late example is immediately diagnosed by a forgotten creation premise.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exact construction with reversed pronouns and an explicit forgotten premise; I infer a deliberate counter-parable contest. The alternative is simple recurrence of a common example formula without global compositional force.

changed_reading.before: The focus parable is a one-way teaching illustration.
changed_reading.after: The focus opens a contest of case-making: its audience will also construct examples, and those examples are tested by what causal history they omit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The response to decayed remains moves through first origination and then the production of burning fire from green tree. These are not static look-alikes but mechanisms that cross opposed states. They sharpen the focus mathal into training in causal transformation: a valid example preserves the power and process connecting unlike endpoints.

activation_trace.role: Following a model or path supplies an analogy that carries a process, not merely a surface resemblance.
Decay and disintegration supply the apparently irreversible endpoint posed by the counter-example.
Bringing a thing into existence supplies the causal capacity omitted by the objection.
The first beginning redirects comparison from the ruined endpoint to the initiating process.
A temporal occurrence supplies repeatability across first and later events.
The living stalked tree supplies the material starting state.
Fresh green vegetation intensifies the apparent opposition to combustion.
Burning fire supplies the transformed endpoint drawn from the green source.
Active ignition makes the opposed-state relation operational in the audience's hands.

structural_cues: 36:78 asks from decay; 36:79 redirects to first origination.
36:80 places green tree and ignited fire in one production sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies decay, origination, recurrence, green material, and ignition; I infer that these passages teach a process-preserving use of analogy and feed that method back into 36:13. The alternative is that they rebut resurrection denial independently of the earlier town example.

changed_reading.before: A useful example compares entities that already look alike.
changed_reading.after: A useful example can disclose a causal path across unlike states, retaining origin and transformation where a superficial comparison forgets them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus supplies dispatch and arrival; repeated return language, culminating in return at the surah's close, supplies the inverse vector. The town episode becomes one station in a larger circulation: agents are sent outward, messages arrive, responses leave effects, and all trajectories return to their originating authority and outcome.

activation_trace.role: Dispatch and release supply the outward leg of the circuit.
Arrival supplies the local endpoint at which the outward leg meets a community.
Return to a prior source introduces the inverse vector inside the town witness's speech.
Return toward outcome or final issue connects beginning with terminus.
The final return closes the whole-surah motion begun by sending and arrival.

structural_cues: The focus combines a passive sent identity with an active arrival verb.
Return recurs through the surah and occupies its final word.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies outward sending, local arrival, and repeated return; I synthesize them into one directional circuit. The alternative is that the return statements concern resurrection independently and should not be projected onto messenger movement.

changed_reading.before: The messengers make a one-way incursion into the town.
changed_reading.after: Their arrival is the local reception point within a dispatch-arrival-return circuit that spans the surah.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates branch-distant water and vessel images for ق ر ي and ج ي ء rather than their ordinary civic and motion senses. It remains anchored in the focus's gathered settlement and arrival construction, while the later bursting springs and loaded vessel provide a coherent receiving-and-carrying material analogy. Downstream prose should mark it as a hydrological model of social reception, not claim that 'town' or 'came' lexically means water here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ٱلْقَرْيَةِ as a gathered receptacle and جَآءَهَا as arrival into it.

activation_trace.role: Gathering water or another substance in a stable receptacle supplies the town-as-basin image.
Water gathered in a depression or around a fort supplies a branch-distant convergence image for arrival.
Wide splitting and outflow supplies a source from which life-bearing content enters the receiving field.
A flowing spring supplies the concrete inflow image that activates the focus receptacle branches.
A vessel circulating in water supplies a bounded carrier analogous to dispatched message-carriers.
Filling a vessel supplies the carried-content side of the reception mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The town is a fixed location into which people walk.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the town is a social basin into which dispatched streams converge, testing whether gathered life receives or rejects what is carried.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the م ث ل branch of exemplary mutilation or deterrent punishment beneath an ordinary parable construction. It remains focus-anchored through مَثَلًا and impact-bearing ٱضْرِبْ, and the story's threatened stoning, painful punishment, terrifying cry, and stilled life make the warning mechanism live. Downstream prose must present this as a punitive undertone activated by the context, not translate مَثَلًا as punishment.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ٱضْرِبْ مَثَلًا, especially the impact branch of ضرب and deterrent-example branch of مثل.

activation_trace.role: One thing striking another supplies the latent impact beneath the rhetorical imperative.
Punishment made an example for deterrence supplies the branch-distant warning potential.
Collected stones supply the concrete threatened impact that activates the focus branches.
Painful punishment makes deterrence explicit within the narrated conflict.
The terrifying cry supplies the eventual exemplary consequence.
Life stilled after motion supplies the consequence that makes the case deterrent.

changed_reading.before: The verse introduces a neutral teaching illustration.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it raises a deterrent exhibit whose narrative impact warns the present audience before the consequence is disclosed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it aligns the command to render an example with the later command-speech through which an event becomes present. It remains anchored in the imperative ٱضْرِبْ and the مثل branch of standing-present, with 36:82 supplying command, utterance, and temporal occurrence. Downstream prose should call this an analogy of performative presentation, not equate prophetic exemplification with divine creation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The imperative ٱضْرِبْ and مَثَلًا as something made to stand present before an audience.

activation_trace.role: Depicting and manifesting supplies the speech-act that makes the town case cognitively present.
Standing upright and present supplies a spatial image for the example's enacted presentation.
Binding command supplies the initiating performative force.
Uttered speech supplies the vehicle by which command is expressed.
Occurrence and presence in time supply the realized endpoint of the command.

changed_reading.before: The imperative asks the messenger to describe an absent story.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the imperative performs presentation: speech makes the exemplary configuration stand present before its hearers.

strongest_changes: The present messenger frame turns the town into a live reception mirror rather than a sealed historical anecdote.
The plural messengers unfold as a reinforced relay, while the man from the farthest edge creates a counter-arrival from within the city.
The repeated single cry scales the town's outcome into a model of universal interruption and gathering.
The exact ضرب-مثل construction returns with reversed pronouns in 36:78, turning the surah into a contest over valid and causally complete examples.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah recurrence repeatedly refunctionalized the focus's own roots: sending became a relay and return circuit, likeness became both a rejected premise and a generative pattern, companionship became transferable affiliation, and the example became evidentiary, scalable, and answerable by a counter-example.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet does not identify the town historically, and none of the retained mechanisms requires that identification.
The forensic and dispatch-return readings depend on compositional links across distant passages rather than explicit genre labels.
The hydrological, punitive, and performative readings are branch-distant activations and should remain explicitly exploratory.
The qarya-to-madina shift supports an internal spatial model, but the packet alone does not settle whether the two nouns mark one place at different scales.
